children.name: Adendrocera flavulum
children.description: , Male. Measurements. Total length: 4.00 mm. Head length: 0.49 mm. Head width: 0.46 mm. Pronotum length: 0.49 mm. Pronotum maximum width: 0.43 mm. Elytron length: 1.2 mm. Elytron maximum width: 0.33 mm. Morphology. Head slightly longer than wide, integument glossy, shagreened, finely punctured, eye moderately large and protruding, occupying close to one-third width of head in dorsal view (Fig. 1 C), postocular area similar in length to eye in lateral view, eye posterior margin straight (Fig. 1 E); antennomeres I and II subequal, around 1.5 × longer than III, IV 2.5 × longer than III, subequal to subsequent antennomeres until X (Fig. 1 D). Pronotum distinctly longer than wide, integument glossy, shagreened, finely punctured, anterior margin slightly rounded, lateral margins subparallel, posterior margin pointed medially (Fig. 1 C). Elytron with dense, setigerous punctures, around 4 × longer than wide (Fig. 1 A). Hind wings with venation as noted in the genus description (Fig. 1 G). Abdomen and aedeagus as noted in the genus description. Coloration. Body overall light brown to pale yellow, head brown, antennomeres I – III pale yellow, IV – VII light brown, pronotum light brown with posterior margin yellowish, elytra light brown, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Female and Immature Stages. Unknown.
